exposure: Nationwide primary postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) prevention and three-step treatment strategy (misoprostol, intrauterine condom tamponade, non-inflatable anti-shock garment, public health tools)
outcome: Maternal mortality due to primary postpartum haemorrhage
cohort: All births occurring in health facilities nationwide in Niger from Jan 1, 2015, to Dec 31, 2020, with information available on 1,380,779 births.
finding: The nationwide PPH prevention and treatment strategy led to a rapid and significant decline in primary postpartum haemorrhage morbidity and mortality across Niger.
